title: A smooth section has a factor étale near its section kernel
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be commutative rings, $B$ an $A$-algebra with $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], $J\subseteq A$ an ideal and $\sigma:B\to A/J$ an $A$-algebra homomorphism. There exist an $A$-algebra $E$ and $A$-algebra homomorphisms $j:B\to E$ and $\tau:E\to A/J$ with $\tau\circ j=\sigma$ such that, for every prime $\mathfrak q$ of $E$ containing $\ker\tau$, there is $s\in E\setminus\mathfrak q$ for which the principal localization $E_s$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away] is etale over $A$ [def-weil-etale-morphism]. No global etale localization or quotient isomorphism is asserted.

source.place: Tag 07M7 (lemma-lift-section-smooth-morphism), first paragraph and second paragraph through the étale-at-primes conclusion, before Tag 07M0

proof.text: Convert affine scheme smoothness to Algebra.Smooth using HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff and RingHom.smooth_algebraMap. Apply the section differential-basis stabilization to get A₁, D, j, τ, n, f and the basis. Equip A/J with its A₁-algebra structure via the composite A₁→D→A/J and regard τ as an A₁-algebra section.

Define a=Ideal.span(range f), C=D/a, jC=(D→C)∘j, and τC=Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ a τ. Each fᵢ is killed by τ, hence a≤ker τ, so the quotient section exists. Its composite with jC is σ by associativity and τj=σ. The ideal a is finitely generated because Fin n is finite, and Algebra.FinitePresentation.quotient makes C finitely presented over A₁.

At each prime q of C containing ker τC, apply the differential-basis quotient theorem to the explicitly constructed section. Both localized cotangent obstructions vanish. Apply exists_etale_away_of_localized_cotangent_vanishing over A₁ to obtain s∉q with C_s étale over A₁.

The map Spec C_s→Spec A₁ followed by Spec A₁→Spec A is étale by Etale.etale_comp. Spec.map_comp and the scalar-tower algebra-map identities identify this composite with the map induced by A→C→C_s. Retain C,jC,τC and the elements s as the required witnesses.

proof_origin.description: Stacks 07M7 reduction into stabilization and localized cotangent vanishing for the explicit basis quotient. The quotient construction, factorization, finite presentation, application of the cotangent criterion and composition of etale morphisms are proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_neighbourhoods_of_smooth_section
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (J : Ideal A) (σ : B →ₐ[A] A ⧸ J)
    (hB : Smooth (Scheme.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)).op)) :
    ∃ (C : CommAlgCat.{u} A) (j : B →ₐ[A] C) (τ : C →ₐ[A] A ⧸ J),
      τ.comp j = σ ∧
      ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum C, RingHom.ker τ.toRingHom ≤ q.asIdeal →
        ∃ s : C, s ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
          Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            ((algebraMap C (Localization.Away s)).comp (algebraMap A C))))
